filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window = Fri Nov 20 (after the morning run) – Mon Nov 23 morning PT, weekend included (items already on the Nov 19–20 briefs not re-led)

market_briefing.lede: CRM agents moved further into default packaging and admin controls over the weekend: Salesforce put Agentforce Coworker into its small-business suites at no added cost, Close opened agents that fire on schedules or CRM events, and Clay let enterprises run its AI through their own AWS accounts.

bullets.text: Nov 23: Agentforce Coworker is now included in Salesforce Starter and Pro Suite for new and existing customers and trialists, with no setup or added cost; it answers pipeline questions, drafts follow-ups and shows each record change for approval before saving.

Nov 21: Close's General Agents (beta) run on a schedule or when a lead, opportunity, call, meeting or form event fires, act with the creator's permissions, pause for approval on tools that aren't pre-approved, and bill in AI credits.
Nov 20: Clay's Amazon Bedrock connection sends supported Clay AI actions through the customer's own AWS account using short-lived, IAM-scoped credentials instead of a stored key.

biggest_ai_news.title: NVIDIA reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 23: the board voted unanimously to bring Huang back as president, CEO and director, citing input from senior US government officials; the independent committee investigation continues and NVIDIA will hire a Chief Compliance Officer.

biggest_ai_news.title: Anthropic closes a $93.5B IPO; ANT ends Friday near the offer price
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 20: underwriters took the full extra 147M shares, lifting IPO gross proceeds to about $93.5B (about $119.5B with the $26B private placement). ANT closed Friday at $88.91, down 8.5% on the day, versus the $83 offer.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI proposes perplexity as a shared progress metric
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 22: chief scientist Jakub Pachocki published OpenAI's internal pretraining perplexity numbers and proposed cross-lab limits on that metric that developers would not cross until monitoring improves.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI's approval rule for model routers is now in force
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 20: services that give third parties direct access to OpenAI models, such as routers and AI gateways, now need OpenAI's review and approval; apps that only use the models for their own features are not covered.

what_changed.title: Salesforce brings Agentforce Coworker to Starter and Pro Suite
what_changed.body: Nov 23: Coworker is built into Salesforce's small-business suites for new and existing customers and trialists, with no setup or added cost. It answers questions like what changed in the pipeline this week, drafts follow-ups, recommends priorities across opportunities and cases, and lists planned field changes for approval before saving.

what_changed.title: Clay lets enterprises run its AI through their own Amazon Bedrock
what_changed.body: Nov 20: supported Clay AI and agent actions can run on Bedrock in the customer's AWS account. Access uses OpenID Connect federation and an IAM role bound to one Clay workspace and connection, so no long-lived AWS key; set up through a Clay Growth Strategist and the customer's AWS admin.

what_changed.title: Close launches General Agents in beta
what_changed.body: Nov 21: Close users describe a task and set a schedule or CRM-event trigger; agents can update leads and opportunities, send email and SMS and create tasks with pre-approved tools, otherwise pausing for approval. Agents inherit the creator's permissions; beta orgs get 250 free AI credits a week.

what_changed.title: Lightfield connects OneDrive and SharePoint to its agent
what_changed.body: Nov 20: files and folders from OneDrive and SharePoint can be attached to records and used by Lightfield's agent; the Files API can import meeting recordings and transcripts up to 512 MB.

quiet_note: No launch, funding, M&A or pricing of their own from Gong, Nooks, Outreach, Salesloft or Monaco dated Nov 20–23. Apollo's Nevara acqui-hire post is dated Nov 18 and Dreamteam's $53M round Nov 16.

market_direction.label: Accelerating (agents bundled into base CRM tiers)
market_direction.text: Salesforce added Coworker to its small-business suites at no added cost (Nov 23), after launching a $50/user/month Coworker SKU on Nov 4.

market_direction.label: Accelerating (triggered agents with pre-approved actions)
market_direction.text: Close's General Agents run on schedules or CRM events and only act without a pause on tools an admin pre-approves (Nov 21).

market_direction.label: New (customer-owned inference inside GTM tools)
market_direction.text: Clay now runs AI actions through the buyer's own Bedrock account (Nov 20), while OpenAI began requiring approval for routers and gateways that resell model access (Nov 20).

market_direction.label: Steady (Gong, Nooks, Outreach, Salesloft, Monaco)
market_direction.text: No new announcements of their own Nov 20–23.

Clay's name for running its AI actions on the customer's own AWS Bedrock under IAM-role access (Nov 20).
Salesforce's framing for the record updates and report pulls Coworker takes over for small teams (Nov 23).

Amazon Bedrock connection: Clay AI actions run on the customer's AWS account via IAM roles (Nov 20).

watch.title: Wed Dec 2: Salesforce Q3 FY27 results
watch.body: Salesforce's IR release, re-checked Nov 23, still says Dec 2 after the close (2:00 PM PT call); a Nov 20 Salesforce LinkedIn post says Dec 3 at 2 PM PT, so confirm the date. First quarter with the $50/user Coworker SKU (Nov 4), the Cresta deal (Nov 2), Copilotforce (Nov 17) and now Coworker in the SMB suites (Nov 23).

interpretation.fact: Nov 23 Salesforce made Agentforce Coworker part of Starter and Pro Suite at no added cost; Nov 21 Close launched General Agents in beta; Nov 20 Clay added an Amazon Bedrock connection and Lightfield added OneDrive/SharePoint. Nov 23 NVIDIA reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO; Nov 20 Anthropic closed its IPO at about $93.5B gross and ANT closed at $88.91; Nov 22 OpenAI proposed perplexity as a shared metric; OpenAI's router/gateway approval rule took effect Nov 20. Gong, Nooks, Outreach, Salesloft and Monaco announced nothing new of their own Nov 20–23.
interpretation.interpretation: Bundling Coworker into the cheapest Salesforce suites makes a basic CRM agent a free default for small teams, pushing paid agents to compete on work a CRM-native assistant doesn't do. Clay's Bedrock option and Close's pre-approved tools point to enterprise buyers asking where inference runs and which actions run unattended before they turn agents on.
